title: Change Admin Panel button font colors to blue for better visibility

requirements.text: Change the font color of all primary action buttons in the Admin Panel to blue, including: 'Log In', 'Log Out', 'Add Product', 'Edit', 'Delete', and any other action buttons in AdminLogin.tsx, AdminPanel.tsx, and ProductManagement.tsx components

quotes: Change the Font colors into blue at the Admin Panel. (i.e.- Log in, Log out, Add Product etc.) It is hard to find the button

acceptanceCriteria: All primary action buttons in AdminLogin component have blue text color
All primary action buttons in AdminPanel component have blue text color
All primary action buttons in ProductManagement component have blue text color
Button text remains legible with sufficient contrast against backgrounds
Blue color is consistent across all admin panel buttons

constraints: Do not modify the authentication logic or backend functionality
Maintain accessibility standards with sufficient color contrast
Keep existing button styling and layouts intact, only change text color
nonGoals: Resolving the authorization issue for adding products (separate concern)
Changing button colors in non-admin sections
Redesigning the entire admin panel layout
